top_signals.title: U.S. Diplomatic Push Revives Hopes for Trans-Caspian Gas Pipeline
top_signals.summary: Trans-Caspian connectivity was the topic du jour during US Deputy Secretary of State Christopher Landau’s November 23 talks with Turkmen leaders in Ashgabat. Readouts of Landau’s meetings hinted that a trans-Caspian pipeline was among the central items on the agenda. The focal point of Landau’s multi-day stop in Turkmenistan was two meetings, one with President Serdar Berdymukhamedov, the other with long-serving Foreign Minister Rashid Meredov.  Both the Turkmen government and the US Embassy in Ashgabat were tight-lipped…
